protocol: Same retrieval (hybrid default), prompts, documents, thresholds and machine (RTX 3050 4 GB) for both models.

The LLM cache is keyed by model, so the models never share answers. Each model runs the whole evaluation twice with cache reads off (LLM_CACHE_READ=0): run 1 starts after unloading every model (cold start measured), run 2 right after (warm). Quality numbers come from run 1; latency from run 2; answers that changed between the runs are listed (sampling noise, temperature 0.1).

Extraction is run once per model and run on BodyComfort R3.2.3, HMI R25-11 and the frozen held-out v4 document (sha256 checked against eval/heldout_v4.lock before anything runs). The deterministic (no LLM) baseline runs once.
Real-document precision is page-scoped: extracted entities on the pages that carry gold rows of that type (eval/real_gold.csv is not exhaustive), so it is a lower bound.
decision_rule: Switch the default model from qwen2.5:3b to qwen3:4b-instruct only if ALL of:

1. (gold Q&A answer correctness of the candidate >= baseline + 8 points, OR mean real-gold extraction F1 >= baseline + 0.05; mean over the entity types whose F1 is defined), measured on the first (cold) run;
2. refusal accuracy on the unanswerable gold questions does not drop;
3. Q&A end-to-end latency p95 of the candidate (second, warm run) stays under 20 s;
4. the candidate fits in the 4 GB GPU without heavy CPU spill: `ollama ps` shows >= 90% of the model on the GPU.
Otherwise keep the baseline. One question = 4 points; differences of 4 points or less are 'no real difference'.

thinking: qwen3:4b-instruct lists the 'thinking' capability in Ollama; every call sends think=false and <think>...</think> blocks are stripped before JSON/citation parsing (none were observed in a manual check).

It determines when the Application Service should be active by requesting focus [C2].

per_question.question: What limitations does the chassis work package state about the software architecture shown in its documents?

per_question.answer: The chassis work package considers all chassis signals as safety relevant [C1]. A joint discussion with the Application System Team and the Safety Team is necessary to ensure safety compliance with ISO 26262 [C1].

These acceleration commands are derived from the ACC SW-Composition and are used to control vehicle velocity and distance to obstacles [C1]. The output is defined in accordance with ISO 15622 standards [C1]. The ACC SW-Composition does not include "Stop&Go" functionality in the current state [C1].

per_question.question: What limitations does the chassis work package state about the software architecture shown in its documents?
per_question.answer: The chassis work package states that its software architecture proposals are not binding and are only for clarification [C1]. It does not define the properties of signal qualifiers, which are instead defined by another AUTOSAR work package [C1]. The work package does not define actuator-specific interfaces such as current or PWM duty cycle, but instead focuses on vehicle-related physical values like torques or forces [C1]. The work package does not provide a safety concept for active chassis systems and relies on project-level implementation [C5].

per_question.question: How does the chassis work package treat the safety relevance of chassis signals?
per_question.answer: The chassis work package considers all chassis signals as safety relevant [C1]. It assumes the availability of reliable communication methods in AUTOSAR for safety-related signal handling [C1]. However, it does not provide a safety concept for active chassis systems and relies on project-level implementation of safety requirements [C1]. A joint discussion with the Application System Team and the Safety Team is necessary to ensure safety compliance with ISO 26262 [C1].

per_question.question: Which has priority if the document and the MasterTable are inconsistent?
per_question.answer: In case of inconsistencies between pictures and explanations in this document and the MasterTable, the information in the MasterTable has to be considered as prior [C1].

per_question.question: What do the naming prefixes Cmd, Req and Sta mean in data element names?
per_question.answer: The prefix "Cmd" means a command that activates or performs an action, typically from a master to an actuator [C1]. The prefix "Req" denotes a request that demands an action, usually from a sensor to a master [C1]. The prefix "Sta" indicates a status that provides functional information about the current state [C1].

per_question.question: What is the data type of the VehicleSpeed signal?
per_question.answer: The data type of the VehicleSpeed signal is uint16 [C2].

per_question.question: What does the PositionSensor component provide?
per_question.answer: The PositionSensor component provides the filtered window position in percent [C2]. It reports the WindowPosition signal to WinCtrlManager and AntiPinchMonitor [C1, C5].

per_question.question: What happens in the automatic close with anti-pinch flow when an obstruction is found?
per_question.answer: When an obstruction is found, AntiPinchMonitor sends a PinchDetected signal to WinCtrlManager [C1, C3]. WinCtrlManager then commands MotorDriver to reverse the window movement [C1]. This action is part of the anti-pinch protection that is active during every closing movement [C2]. The obstruction detection relies on evaluating WindowPosition and motor load during the closing phase [C1].

per_question.question: At which supply voltage range do all window movements stop?
per_question.answer: All window movements stop when the supply voltage leaves the 9 V to 16 V range [C1].

per_question.question: Within what time is a window request answered?
per_question.answer: A window request is answered within 50 ms [C1].

The ButtonPanel serves as a virtual placeholder for system-specific UI Device SWCs [C1]. It aggregates standardized ports and interfaces for common UI devices like buttons and LEDs [C1]. The simple button interface supports binary input (pressed/not pressed) for basic user requests [C2]. The multi-state button interface handles discrete values for devices with multiple physical positions [C3].
